ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets and stems, several pieces, florets dense and slightly textured, stems pale green and firm, scattered across the upper and lower left of the bowl, about 2-4 cm across each, spread over roughly 20% of the bowl surface | 90
ITEM 2 | Cubed pale tan-beige pieces with lightly browned, slightly golden outer edges, firm and matte surface, cut into roughly 1.5-2 cm cubes, clustered in the center and lower half of the bowl, covering about 25% of the bowl surface | 110
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens with frilled edges, in deep burgundy-red, dark green and light green leaves, crisp and moist-looking, spread across most of the bowl as a base, covering about 45% of the bowl surface | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin white shaved or flaked cheese slivers, pale ivory, slightly translucent edges, dry and flat, scattered over the greens and between the cubes, covering about 8% of the bowl surface | 12
